name: knowledge
description: Ingest external knowledge into durable, synthesized artifacts. Ships a book-distillation pipeline (PDF/EPUB into concept-organized, author-attributed skill reference files), a YouTube pipeline (watch, transcript, link harvest, and repo-applicability synthesis), and a course-digest pipeline (extract and synthesize online video courses — Dometrain, Teachable — into repo-applicable recommendations), plus a re-runnable setup action; a configurable library directory governs where synthesized artifacts land in the consuming repo.

library_dir.title: Knowledge library directory
library_dir.description: Project-relative directory in the consuming repo where synthesized knowledge artifacts land. Default is the repo root. A working-notes or artifacts convention declared in your own project's CLAUDE.md or rules takes precedence.

yt_dlp_js_runtimes.title: yt-dlp JS runtimes (youtube-digest)
yt_dlp_js_runtimes.description: JavaScript runtime yt-dlp uses for YouTube signature deciphering. Default 'node'. Set to 'off' to omit the --js-runtimes flag entirely.

yt_dlp_cookies_file.title: yt-dlp cookies file (youtube-digest)
yt_dlp_cookies_file.description: Path to a Netscape-format cookies.txt for authenticated YouTube acquisition. Empty by default (unauthenticated, with automatic browser-cookie fallback on a bot check). Never commit cookie files.

yt_dlp_cookies_from_browser.title: yt-dlp cookies from browser (youtube-digest)
yt_dlp_cookies_from_browser.description: Browser to pull YouTube cookies from (e.g. chrome, firefox, edge), forcing one instead of the automatic platform-ordered fallback. Empty by default. A cookies file, when set, wins over this.

max_concurrent_acquires.title: Max concurrent acquisitions (youtube-digest)
max_concurrent_acquires.description: Cap on concurrent yt-dlp acquisition runs during a batch. Default 1; raising it increases HTTP 429 throttling risk.
